title: Auth: "redirect straight to the identity provider" — with SSO configured, skip the sign-in page and return to the original page; the local sign-in path is configurable
body:
repo:cloud#5 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPP1zuWBNq3nBXVei9

Filing gate: ④ a child of the topic card objectstack-ai/cloud#4465 (the maintainer's rulings 1-10 of 2026-11-13/14 are recorded there; read it first). 

## 维护者速读

平台统一功能：开了单点登录后，打开环境不再显示登录页，直接跳到身份提供方，登录后回到原来的页面。本地登录入口可以配置：自托管可以保留一个隐藏地址；托管上关闭，按裁决 10，托管没有本地登录。云端会把这个功能默认打开。

## Work (objectstack-ai/cloud#4465 ruling 8, child 4a)
- Add one setting: when SSO is configured, an unauthenticated visit goes straight to the configured IdP, preserving the return URL.
- The local sign-in path is configurable: on with a hidden path (for example `/login?local=1`), or off.
- Self-hosted deployments with their own IdP can enable it. The cloud enables it by default with the local path off (cloud card C6).
- API keys, MCP and the API are unaffected.

Suggested `priority:p1`. Routing: triage (plugin-auth plus the console login page).

`priority:p1` on the maintainer's word, verbatim (seat session `session_01Q4EjjPP1zuWBNq3nBXVei9`, 2026-11-14): 「都是p1，车道自己认领就可以」. Triage routes it to its lane; the lane claims it.
